harf.append: Ex: she says it as a phrase, never alone — the clip is her Harf waaw, "the letter waaw".
harf.why: the clip is the phrase, so the card should say so rather than imply the bare word

sahh.append: Ex: the clip catches her questioning tone — SaHH?, "right?" — which is the second use above.
sahh.why: the recovered clip has the rising intonation

maa_ism_abuuka.append: Ex: the same question to a woman, in her voice [sound:arabic_khouri_maa_ism_abuuki.mp3]
